search_terms: Task14 fronted self Q K Q2 K2 factorial

closest_prior_work.relation: Localized essentially all conditional score correction to the final subject's self score, but explicitly left Q, K, Q2, and K2 unresolved.
Provides a method precedent for exact 16-corner query/key accounting on another circuit; it did not test Task14, L11H3, or the fronted self term.

novelty: First exact Task14 localization of the fronted final-subject self score across its four normalized rotary factors q, k, q2, and k2. With donor u8 fixed and every non-self source term native, evaluate all 16 recipient/donor factor corners in p8=(q dot k/128)(q2 dot k2/128), then run the real downstream model and measure answer margin and CE.

registered_screens.qk1_pair_sufficiency: donor q and k with native q2 and k2 recover at least 70 percent of the signed 1111-minus-0000 task-margin effect in both direction cells, with at least 75 percent row agreement with the cell-total sign and CE contribution having the same sign as total CE
registered_screens.qk2_pair_sufficiency: independently, donor q2 and k2 with native q and k meet the same two-cell signed-recovery, row-direction, and CE-sign bars; both branch screens may pass
registered_screens.branch_composition_dependence: the named two-branch interaction v1111-v0011-v1100+v0000 has absolute magnitude at least 10 percent of the total, the same sign in both direction cells, and that sign repeats in both deterministic lexical halves

required_controls: native recipient and donor task capability in both fronted direction cells
exact native replay and source-term sum
fixed donor projected value u8 and native source terms for every k other than 8
0000 and 1111 reproduce the opened donor-value and donor-self-score endpoints row by row
every installed self term equals the constructed scalar p8 times donor u8
all four factor vectors and both natural branch scalar scores are finite, nonzero, and recipient-donor distinct
all 16 masks occur exactly once per row; exact four-factor Mobius reconstruction and Shapley efficiency
interpretation_limits: This is a QK algebra/localization screen, not identification of four natural causal variables.

At a self source q, k, q2, and k2 naturally come from the same residual vector. The 14 mixed corners break that tie and probe an off-diagonal bilinear extension, so individual query-versus-key effects are descriptive and require later natural-counterfactual validation.
The scalar cross-kernel corners are invariant under paired query/key gauge changes, but the two QK branch labels retain an exchange symmetry.
OOD text is reused; pristine OOD, selectivity, completeness, and semantic naming remain closed.
